patterns.comment: sector Name<type: param, ...> ?label { — declaration with generics + optional deferred label
sector generic params: outerVar, *innerName or outerVar, innerName
sector Name ?label { — simple declaration with optional deferred label
object Name<params> { — object declaration with generics
object Name { — object declaration without generics
method Name<type, *params...> ?alias { — method declaration with multi-params
method params: *varName inside <> — star-prefixed scope injection
call labelname<args> capture; or call labelname(args) capture;
label<params>: — instruction label with parameters inside object
